scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof and reproducible numerical cross-checks; self-review only. Older specialist spline calculations may contain equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: Real continuous piecewise-linear splines on exactly five distinct symmetric knots with Lebesgue L2 projection; no claim for nonsymmetric partitions or polynomial degree above one. Clustering values are limiting norms, not merged-knot projection norms.
title: Sharp endpoint stability and optimal knot balance for symmetric five-node linear splines
